=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text m1 "abc"
text m2 "Rosetta code"
text m3 "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."
global kt uint 64
global hs uint 8
global w uint 64
global blk uchar 128
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitx writes n as 8 lowercase hex digits
fn emitx n uint to void
d = new uchar 8 0
v = n
for i ulong 8
q = uchar and v 15
if lt q 10
put d sub 7 i add q 48
else
put d sub 7 i add q 87
end
v = shr v 4
end
emit d
end
note FIPS 180-4 constants, copied mechanically from aien-dev/omega-mv om/sha256/sha256-om2.om

fn iv to void
put hs 0 0x6a09e667
put hs 1 0xbb67ae85
put hs 2 0x3c6ef372
put hs 3 0xa54ff53a
put hs 4 0x510e527f
put hs 5 0x9b05688c
put hs 6 0x1f83d9ab
put hs 7 0x5be0cd19
end
fn bs0 x uint to uint
ret xor xor rotr x 2 rotr x 13 rotr x 22
end
fn bs1 x uint to uint
ret xor xor rotr x 6 rotr x 11 rotr x 25
end
fn ss0 x uint to uint
ret xor xor rotr x 7 rotr x 18 shr x 3
end
fn ss1 x uint to uint
ret xor xor rotr x 17 rotr x 19 shr x 10
end
fn ch e uint f uint g uint to uint
ret xor and e f and not e g
end
fn maj a uint b uint c uint to uint
ret xor xor and a b and a c and b c
end
note compress the 64-byte block blk[o .. o+64) into hs
fn compress o ulong to void
for i ulong 16
j = add o mul i 4
x = shl uint get blk j 24
x = or x shl uint get blk add j 1 16
x = or x shl uint get blk add j 2 8
x = or x uint get blk add j 3
put w i x
end
for i ulong 48
x = add get w i ss0 get w add i 1
x = add x get w add i 9
x = add x ss1 get w add i 14
put w add i 16 x
end
a = get hs 0
b = get hs 1
c = get hs 2
d = get hs 3
e = get hs 4
f = get hs 5
g = get hs 6
h = get hs 7
for i ulong 64
t1 = add h bs1 e
t1 = add t1 ch e f g
t1 = add t1 get kt i
t1 = add t1 get w i
t2 = add bs0 a maj a b c
h = g
g = f
f = e
e = add d t1
d = c
c = b
b = a
a = add t1 t2
end
put hs 0 add get hs 0 a
put hs 1 add get hs 1 b
put hs 2 add get hs 2 c
put hs 3 add get hs 3 d
put hs 4 add get hs 4 e
put hs 5 add get hs 5 f
put hs 6 add get hs 6 g
put hs 7 add get hs 7 h
end
note one or two blocks: messages up to 119 bytes (longer traps 3 at the first put past blk)
fn sha a view uchar * to void
n = len a
for i ulong 128
put blk i 0
end
for i ulong n
put blk i get a i
end
put blk n 128
total = ulong 64
if gt n 55
total = 128
end
bits = mul n 8
for i ulong 8
put blk sub total add i 1 uchar and shr bits mul i 8 255
end
iv
compress 0
if eq total 128
compress 64
end
for i ulong 8
emitx get hs i
end
emit nl
end
fn main to int
kinit
sha m1
sha m2
sha m3
ret 0
end
